{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
print("Unique revenue values (first 10):", df['revenue'].unique()[:10])
print("\nSample of revenue strings:")
print(df['revenue'].head(10))

# Check if any contain commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nRows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Confirm that all non-null revenue values have commas or are decimal
print(f"\nTotal non-null revenue: {df['revenue'].notna().sum()}")
print(f"\nRevenue values with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")"}
